_doc: Curated list of the kana words that inline links can point at the wrong entry. build/auto_link.py links a kana token to the one entry with that reading; this file records, for every kana base form that such links use (surface and base both hiragana, not a function-table word), whether the kana string can stand for a different word in practice. Screened by a model (build/review_links.py --screen), confirmed by in-context occurrence review; tiers are re-derived from reviews/link_decisions.jsonl by build/check_link_homophones.py --retier. A base may be edited by hand; set tier_locked to keep a hand-set tier through --retier.

tiers.unique: The string means only this entry's word in practice. The linker links it freely; no review.
tiers.verify: A same-kana competitor exists but the entry's word dominates. The linker links it; the Routine self-check reviews each new occurrence in context (review_links.py --ids).
tiers.block: The competitor is common enough that a context-free link is wrong too often. The linker never links it from kana; an existing or hand-placed link needs a keep line in reviews/link_decisions.jsonl (CI: check_link_homophones.py --gate).

fields.target: the entry the links point at
fields.competitors: other words the same kana can stand for, from the screen
fields.screen: the model's type-level verdict (unique | ambiguous), risk (none | rare | common), model and date
fields.review: adjudicated occurrences from the ledger: reviewed, wrong, date (written by --retier)
